title: Kilim: Fast, lightweight, cheap message passing in Java.
summary: A Google Tech Talk by the author of Kilim, a Java library for lightweight actor-style message passing. It argues that message passing can replace shared-memory concurrency and claims performance competitive with or better than Erlang for huge numbers of actors.
why: Pointed to as evidence that Java can do fast, cheap message-passing concurrency, as an alternative to Erlang or Scala actors.

quote.text: Kilim's author did a nice Google Talk
